rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physical paralysis and for a person, organization, or system being unable to function.

example.english: After his stroke, paralysis affected his right arm and leg, so he needed help walking.
example.traditional: 佢中風之後，右手右腳都癱瘓，行路要人扶。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung3 fung1 zi1 hau6 jau6 sau2 jau6 goek3 dou1 taan1 wun6 haang4 lou6 jiu3 jan4 fu4

rows.note: Use this specifically for paralysis affecting one side of the body, especially after a stroke.

example.english: After his stroke, my uncle had paralysis on one side and needed a wheelchair to go out.
example.traditional: 我伯伯中風後半身不遂，出街一定要坐輪椅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 baak3 baak3 zung3 fung1 hau6 bun3 san1 bat1 seoi6 ceot1 gaai1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zo6 leon4 ji2

rows.note: Use this for an organization, system, or activity that has stopped functioning rather than for physical paralysis.

example.english: The departments kept passing the buck, causing paralysis in the project.
example.traditional: 幾個部門互相推卸責任，令個計劃陷入停擺。
example.jyutping: gei2 go3 bou6 mun4 wu6 soeng1 teoi1 se3 zaak3 jam6 ling6 go3 gai3 waak6 haam6 jap6 ting4 baai2
